name: Personal Loan Application and Drawdown
orchestration_notes: Customer applies for a personal loan via a channel. CAP-001 (Retail Banking) owns the loan origination and account lifecycle. CAP-004 (Risk Management) performs creditworthiness assessment via async events. CAP-005 (Compliance) monitors for AML obligations. Cross-capability coordination is exclusively event-driven.

regulatory_basis.obligation: Personal loans under £25,000 are regulated credit agreements. Pre-contractual information must be provided (SECCI form). Customer has 14-day withdrawal right after agreement execution.
Creditworthiness assessment required before granting credit. Assessment must consider income, committed expenditure, and credit history. Unaffordable lending is prohibited under Consumer Duty.
Loan must offer fair value relative to APR and market rates. Affordability must be genuinely assessed — not superficial tick-box compliance.
If the loan decision is made by automated processing, the customer must be informed and has the right to request human review of a rejected application.

phases.name: Loan Application Submission
phases.description: Customer applies for a personal loan via the channel. They specify the loan amount (£1,000–£25,000), term (12–84 months), and purpose. The channel presents an indicative APR (subject to credit assessment) and a pre-contractual Standard European Consumer Credit Information (SECCI) form. Customer completes the application including income, employment status, and monthly committed expenditure. SCA required to authenticate the application.
persona_actions: Customer selects loan amount, term, and purpose
Customer reviews indicative APR (variable based on credit profile — final APR determined after assessment)
Customer reviews and acknowledges SECCI form (pre-contractual information)
Customer provides income details: employment status, gross monthly income, employer
Customer provides committed expenditure: monthly rent/mortgage, existing credit commitments, childcare
Customer completes SCA to authenticate application
system_actions: Channel presents indicative rate range and SECCI form based on selected amount and term
SVC-100 (IAM) validates SCA for application submission
SVC-001 creates LoanApplication: status = submitted, with income, expenditure, loan_amount, term, purpose
SVC-001 publishes LoanApplicationSubmitted (EVT-152)
SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) consumes LoanApplicationSubmitted to initiate credit assessment
phases.exit_condition: LoanApplication created with status = submitted; LoanApplicationSubmitted published
nfr_references: SECCI form presented before application submission (CCA 1974)

phases.name: Creditworthiness and Affordability Assessment
phases.description: SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) performs a credit assessment: credit bureau check (hard or soft), income verification, debt-to-income ratio calculation, and affordability stress test. The assessment produces a credit_score, risk_band, recommended_apr, and approval_decision (approved / referred / declined). A soft credit check is used for indicative decisions; a hard check is performed only on confirmed application.
persona_actions: Customer waits — no customer action during assessment
system_actions: SVC-012 runs credit bureau check (hard search via Experian/Equifax/TransUnion)
SVC-012 calculates debt-to-income ratio: (committed_expenditure + proposed_loan_repayment) / gross_monthly_income
SVC-012 applies affordability stress test: can the customer afford repayments if interest rates rise 3%?
SVC-012 publishes CreditAssessmentCompleted (EVT-153) with credit_score, risk_band, recommended_apr, approval_decision
SVC-001 consumes CreditAssessmentCompleted: if approved, creates LoanOffer; if referred, routes to manual review; if declined, records decline with reason
SVC-014 (KYC/AML) consumes LoanApplicationSubmitted for AML loan origination monitoring
phases.exit_condition: CreditAssessmentCompleted published; LoanApplication status updated (approved / referred / declined)
nfr_references: Hard search only on confirmed application — not browsing

phases.name: Loan Offer and Agreement Execution
phases.description: SVC-001 presents the loan offer to the customer via the channel: approved loan amount, final APR, monthly repayment amount, total repayable, and loan term. The customer reviews the pre-contract credit agreement (CONC-compliant). Customer has 14-day withdrawal right. Customer signs the credit agreement electronically (SCA required). Credit agreement is executed.
persona_actions: Customer reviews final loan offer: amount, APR, monthly repayment, total cost of credit
Customer reviews and accepts full credit agreement (CONC-compliant pre-contract document)
Customer completes SCA to sign agreement electronically
system_actions: SVC-001 presents LoanOffer via channel: loan_amount, apr, monthly_repayment, total_repayable, term, withdrawal_deadline
SVC-100 validates SCA for agreement signing
SVC-001 creates LoanAgreement: status = executed, agreement_date, repayment_schedule
SVC-001 updates LoanApplication status = agreement_executed
SVC-001 publishes LoanAgreementExecuted (EVT-154)
SVC-015
phases.exit_condition: LoanAgreement created with status = executed; LoanAgreementExecuted published

phases.name: Loan Drawdown and Account Activation
phases.description: Following agreement execution (and expiry of the 14-day reflection period is waived in the standard direct lending scenario — funds disbursed immediately on execution per CONC), SVC-001 disburses the loan proceeds to the customer's nominated account. A LoanAccount is created as the servicing vehicle for repayments.
persona_actions: Customer sees funds in their nominated account
system_actions: SVC-001 creates LoanAccount: account_number, sort_code, status = active, outstanding_balance = loan_amount
SVC-009 (Domestic Payments) executes funds transfer to customer's nominated current account
SVC-001 updates LoanAccount status = active; outstanding_balance set
SVC-001 publishes LoanDrawdownCompleted (EVT-155)
SVC-053 (Notifications) dispatches disbursement confirmation: amount, repayment start date, direct debit details
SVC-103 records loan drawdown in audit log
phases.exit_condition: Loan proceeds disbursed; LoanAccount active; LoanDrawdownCompleted published

happy_path.description: Existing customer applies for £10,000 personal loan over 36 months for home improvement. Automated credit assessment approves with APR 6.9%. Customer accepts offer and signs agreement. Funds disbursed to current account within 60 seconds of agreement execution.

alternative_paths.name: Referred to Manual Underwriter
alternative_paths.description: Automated assessment returns referred. A human underwriter reviews the application. Decision within 2 business days. Additional documentation may be required (payslips, bank statements).

alternative_paths.name: Customer Exercises 14-Day Withdrawal Right
alternative_paths.description: Customer executes the agreement but then exercises their 14-day statutory withdrawal right (CCA 1974 s.66A). Customer must repay any drawn funds plus accrued interest within 30 days. LoanAgreement status updated to withdrawn.
additional_steps: Customer submits withdrawal notice within 14 days
SVC-001 calculates accrued interest and issues repayment demand

exception_paths.name: Application Declined
exception_paths.description: Credit assessment declines the application. Customer informed of decline with reasons (subject to automated decision-making transparency under UK GDPR Article 22). Customer offered option to request human review. Decline reason recorded.
exception_paths.customer_message: We're sorry, we are unable to offer you a loan at this time. [Reason: credit score below threshold / affordability assessment failed]. You have the right to request a review of this decision by a human underwriter.
exception_paths.internal_action: LoanApplication status = declined; soft decline reason recorded; UK GDPR Article 22 disclosure provided

exception_paths.name: Disbursement Failure
exception_paths.description: Funds transfer to customer's nominated account fails (invalid account, payment processing error). LoanAccount is created but status = pending_disbursement. Customer notified. Operations team alerted.
exception_paths.trigger: SVC-009 returns payment failure for loan disbursement
exception_paths.customer_message: Your loan has been approved but we couldn't transfer the funds. Please contact us.
exception_paths.internal_action: LoanAccount status = pending_disbursement; PER-058 (Operations) alerted; re-attempt within 2 hours

design_decisions.decision: Hard credit search performed only on confirmed application (PH-112), not during the indicative rate quote phase (PH-111).
design_decisions.rationale: CONC 4.2 requires proportionate creditworthiness assessment. A hard search at quote stage would damage the customer's credit file without their intent to proceed. Soft search used for eligibility check; hard search at confirmed application.
design_decisions.rejected_because: FCA guidance and Consumer Duty require the bank not to damage customers' interests unnecessarily. Hard search without intent to proceed is a known Consumer Duty concern.

design_decisions.decision: Credit assessment (SVC-012, CAP-004) communicates results to Retail Banking (SVC-001, CAP-001) via async event (CreditAssessmentCompleted), not a synchronous API call.
design_decisions.rationale: CAP-004 (Risk Management) must not be called synchronously from CAP-001 — cross-capability sync calls are prohibited by the architecture principle. The event-driven approach also allows the assessment to be re-run without blocking the customer session.
design_decisions.rejected_because: Violates architecture principle: cross-capability communication is exclusively async events.
